question: Can technical unavailability, interruption and recovery be made explicit around the frozen Stage without becoming Character behavior, fictional time, causal history, accepted Production change or implied Stage restart?
accepted_grammar: Healthy infrastructure remains quiet; no permanent status chrome is required merely because persistence or capability state exists.
When requested capability is unavailable before fiction, the existing Stage context and Character states remain unchanged while the application explains the technical boundary outside the fiction.
Capability unavailable is not Character refusal, incapacity, silence, waiting, fictional absence or narrative event.
Persistence in progress is application state, not fictional delay and does not advance Scene time.
Persistence failure is distinct from corruption/integrity concern; neither becomes story damage.
Read-only or recovery-needed application truth may constrain creator action without rewriting Character agency or Production history.
Return restores prior application task/context/focus when safe and is not a Take, rewind, replay or Undo.

defects_repaired: The first exception specimen relabeled all Characters as 'Prior current state', which invented a new Stage-state vocabulary and risked implying stale/frozen fiction. The final specimen preserves the existing speaking/listening/current-opportunity states unchanged.
The state-preservation rewrite introduced mojibake through a PowerShell encoding path. The exact source was repaired byte-safely to UTF-8 and all five browser cases were rerun.

explicit_non_authority: No retry, provider-fallback, cancellation, timeout, progress or automatic recovery policy is frozen.
No autosave/save-point, transactionality, local/cloud, backup, conflict or durability semantics are frozen.
No technical failure creates dialogue, silence, refusal, Character incapacity, Scene history or accepted consequence.
No recovery outcome implies Scene restart, Another Take, rehearsal, branch, timeline rollback or replay.
No transcript-dependent motion, cadence, timing or turn-taking authority is consumed; Q-DESIGN-02 remains blocked.
No final labels, severity vocabulary, icons, notifications/dialogs, provider/model/cost semantics, WinUI implementation, runtime or shipping authority is created.
next_boundary: Run a consolidated Phase-2 static-coverage audit against the entry gate, Stage authority and five completed static studies. Identify any materially under-detailed non-transcript-dependent Stage surface before fresh Engineering reconciliation or holding for Q-DESIGN-02.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
